verified_facts.text: Al Maha sits within the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled within the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa

verified_facts.text: The Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve is the UAE's first national park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve (DDCR) is the UAE’s first national park and an integral part of Dubai’s natural heritage.

verified_facts.text: The reserve covers 225 square kilometres of unspoiled desert, about 5% of Dubai's total land area.

verified_facts.text: Each villa has its own temperature-controlled swimming pool.
